title: Termwise affine Hom evaluation on K-injective targets
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be an affine morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Put $A=f_*\mathcal O_X$ and $Y_A=(Y,A)$ [def-sc-direct-image-algebra-derived-category], and let $T:\mathrm{Mod}(A)\to\mathrm{Mod}(\mathcal O_Y)$ be scalar restriction. Assume the derived category $D(\mathcal O_Y)$ exists [def-pc-derived-category], with localization $Q$ of cochain complexes [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. Let $H:\mathrm{Mod}(\mathcal O_Y)\to\mathrm{Mod}(A)$ be additive, let $i_H:T\circ H\simeq\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_Y}(T(A),-)$ [def-pur-sheaf-hom], and let $T\dashv H$ have counit $\epsilon_0$. Suppose for every module $F$, open $U$ of $Y$, and section $\phi$ of $H(F)$ on $U$, $\epsilon_{0,F}(\phi)=i_H(\phi)(1)$ on $U$. There is a natural isomorphism $j:R\mathcal Hom(\mathcal O_Y[0],-)\simeq\mathrm{Id}_{D(\mathcal O_Y)}$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] such that for every K-injective complex $I$, there is an isomorphism $c:Q(T^\bullet(H^\bullet(I)))\simeq R\mathcal Hom(A[0],QI)$ satisfying $c;R\mathcal Hom(\mathcal O_Y\to A,QI);j_{QI}=Q(\epsilon_0^\bullet(I))$. No derived adjunction or derived algebra-valued functor is assumed.

proof.text: Apply affine_hom_complex_evaluation to obtain the natural unit Hom-complex isomorphism e and the chain isomorphism d, with its chain-level counit equation.
Apply derived_single_hom_evaluation to e, obtaining j and c for B=f_*O_X and the canonical unit map k:O_Y to B, on each K-injective I.

Compose Q.mapIso d with c. By associativity and the equation for c, the evaluation composite is Q(d.hom) followed by Q of chain precomposition and e. Functor.map_comp combines the two localized chain maps; the equation for d identifies their composite with the termwise counit.

theorem affine_hom_kInjective_evaluation
    {Y X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsAffineHom f]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wY} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    (H : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace) ⥤
        SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f)))
      [H.Additive]
      (iH : H ⋙ SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
          (R := moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)
          (R' := moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f))
          ⟨Functor.whiskerRight f.c (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)⟩ ≅
        (SheafOfModules.homFunctor Y.sheaf).obj
          (op ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
            (R := moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)
            (R' := moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f))
            ⟨Functor.whiskerRight f.c (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)⟩).obj
              (SheafOfModules.unit (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f))))))
      (adj₀ : SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
          (R := moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)
          (R' := moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f))
          ⟨Functor.whiskerRight f.c (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)⟩ ⊣ H)
    (h_eval : ∀ (F : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) (U : Y.Opens)
          (φ : (H.obj F).val.obj (op U)),
        ((adj₀.counit.app F).val.app (op U)).hom φ =
          ((((iH.hom.app F).val.app (op U)).hom φ).app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))).hom
            (1 : (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f)).obj.obj (op U))) :
    ∃ j : (Functor.curry.obj
        (derivedInternalHom (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) Y.toRingedSpace.sheaf)).obj
          (op ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
              (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf))) ≅ 𝟭 _,
      ∀ (I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
        (_ : I.IsKInjective),
      ∃ c : DerivedCategory.Q.obj
          (((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
            (R := moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)
            (R' := moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f))
            ⟨Functor.whiskerRight f.c (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)⟩).mapHomologicalComplex
              (.up ℤ)).obj ((H.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj I)) ≅
          (derivedInternalHom (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) Y.toRingedSpace.sheaf).obj
            (op ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
              (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
                ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf))),
              DerivedCategory.Q.obj I),
        c.hom ≫ (derivedInternalHom (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y)
            Y.toRingedSpace.sheaf).map
          (((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0).map
              (SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit f.toRingCatSheafHom)).op,
            𝟙 (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I)) ≫
          j.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I) =
            DerivedCategory.Q.map
              ((NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex adj₀.counit (.up ℤ)).app I)
